headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Offers N800 Billion in Treasury Bills
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria offered N800 billion in treasury bills as commercial bank placements at its Standing Deposit Facility reached N6.98 trillion.
why: Treasury bill issuances and central bank liquidity management operations influence domestic interest rates and short-term fixed-income yields.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Large treasury bill auctions absorb excess banking system liquidity, influencing short-term yields and credit availability.
